products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as a provider of trusted technology and human expertise for healthcare decision-making and performance. The company offers a range of products spanning clinical decision support, clinical data management, enterprise imaging, and health data analytics. Its named products include Micromedex, a clinical decision support solution for point-of-care insights; Zelta, a cloud-based clinical data management and acquisition platform designed for clinical trials; the Merge suite of enterprise imaging and workflow tools including Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, Merge Workflow Orchestrator, Merge Cardio, and Merge Hemo; and Truven, a health data and analytics offering backed by consulting services. Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo were ranked Best in KLAS for 2025 according to the site.

The company also offers a portfolio focused on real-world evidence studies and population health analytics. Customer-reported outcomes cited on the site include an increase in auto-renewal rates for MAGI Medicaid from 17% to 80%, 36,000 hours in time savings, and nearly $1.3 million in cost savings within a single cohort. The site also references a customer expectation that identifying fetal toxicities could be reduced from a ten-year timeline to fewer than five years using Merative data.

The held facts note that Merative was formerly known as Watson Health, and categorize its work under healthcare and life sciences AI, covering healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance.
